title: Paloma and the Harbor
author: Marguerite Sterling
blurb: Dominic Lockridge, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
